cover letter
General knowledge of library practices and procedures, which may be acquired through library experience, specialized training, or relevant academic preparation.
Academic library experience.
Experience with circulation services and/or technical processing in a library.
Experience with and/or the ability to learn the Alma integrated library system (ILS).
Recent experience with an integrated library system (ILS) and understanding of ILS bibliographic, item and holdings records.

Experience using common software applications, such as Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint), Google Drive (Docs and Spreadsheets), cloud data storage, such as Box, and email applications, such as Gmail, Outlook or bCal.

The Circulation Assistant (Late Night) supports 24-hour circulation services for enrolled students, faculty, staff, and non-UC affiliated library card-holders. This position performs all duties associated with providing access to collections and explains and interprets library policies and procedures as necessary. Serving as the sole library career staff during late night and early morning hours, the Circulation Assistant (Late Night) assists users at the Circulation Desk with checking materials in and out, renewing items, placing holds, requesting material from the NRLF, and managing study room reservations and electronic device loans.

Adds volume/copy information and changes circulation codes in local online catalog; handles difficult communications and complaints referred from lower-level staff; corresponds with faculty, staff, and other patrons.

Additional responsibilities include assisting the circulation supervisor with electronic device maintenance and inventory, handling day-to-day circulation record cleanup, and serving as a workleader by training and monitoring student library employees. This position also provides support to Library Security during emergencies, manages assignments at the Privileges Desk to issue library cards and resolve billing issues, and contributes to the e-reserves operations team by processing course reserve request lists.
Serves as the sole library career staff during the late night/early morning hours (Monday through Friday 2am-11am during the semester).
Explains and interprets library policies and procedures (enforce policies when necessary).

Assists library users at the Circulation Desk, including checking out/in, renewing and placing holds on library materials, requesting material from NRLF, reserving and monitoring study rooms, and checking out electronic devices.
Answers user inquiries (in person, via email or telephone).
Serves as workleader training, assigning tasks, and monitoring the performance of circulation desk student library employees working the late shift.
In addition, provides support to Information Desk student library employees and Library Security as needed, especially emergencies.
Collection Maintenance and Stacks Management - 25%
Performs advanced bibliographic verification; recalls NRLF materials and prepares NRLF deposits; makes final scanning determination on brittle, disintegrating volumes.
Assists the Circulation Supervisor with electronic devices, including re-imaging machines, checking for damage, maintaining inventory, and monitoring usage.
May assist with compiling electronic device use statistics.

Assist the Circulation Supervisor with day-to-day circulation related duties, including handling snags, maintaining statistics, editing and updating item records, and other record cleanup projects as assigned.
Reference and Instruction - 10%
Serves at a reference desk or general public service desk providing routine information.

Maintains a regular Privileges Desk assignment (in person and online via LibAnswers) assisting library users: issues library cards and borrowing privileges, interprets library policies and procedures as related to library access and borrowing, and resolves problems, and answers questions regarding billing or borrowing issues.
Replies to users regarding circulation policies or billing questions, and refers privileges/borrowing inquiries to the Privileges Desk.
E-Reserves Operations - 5%
Serves as a member of the e-reserves operations team processing course reserves request lists in a timely manner.
Performs bibliographic checking of citations provided by faculty members to determine whether the Library owns an item requested for course reserves.
Works with e-reserves coordinator to find alternatives, if the Library does not own the requested material.
Follow process for purchasing requests as outlined by e-reserves coordinator.
Excellent analytical, organizational, problem solving, interpersonal, and communication skills.
